title: Legacy character prose description migration to structured persona

sections.what: Build an offline / CLI tool (`tools/migrate_prose_to_persona.py`) and an inspector action that parses unstructured character description paragraphs into the 4-part persona block (`identity`, `appearance`, `personality`, `narrative`), keeping existing prose intact as `base_description`.
sections.why: Older scenarios (and imported third-party character cards) have multi-paragraph descriptions mixing eye color, height, speech quirks, and backstory into a single prose wall. Converting them to structured persona blocks manually is tedious and error-prone.
sections.how:
- Implement an extraction pipeline in `tools/migrate_prose_to_persona.py` using LLM entity extraction and heuristic regex matching for age, height, eye color, hair, and clothing.
- Allow dry-run review before applying updates to scenario JSON files.
- Add unit tests verifying schema conformance of generated persona blocks.

acceptance.text: CLI tool can parse a character prose description into a valid persona schema block.
Converted persona block round-trips through validation without dropping prose context.
Tested on sample character descriptions from Kraktooth and Millwood.
